result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hazardous, characterized by a wide, multi-lane arterial road with no marked crossings or refuge areas. While a sidewalk exists on the right, the lack of infrastructure for crossing and the high-speed nature of the road create a significant barrier to safe pedestrian movement.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide, undivided roadway requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes of traffic without any protected refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Spanning the width of the road in the center and foreground

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Crossing Infrastructure
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian signals are visible, providing no designated or safe way to cross the arterial.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection area in the middle ground

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross the wide road in two stages.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks and Signage
interventions.description: Mark crossings with high-visibility paint and add pedestrian crossing warning signs to alert drivers.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reconfigure the roadway to reduce the number of through lanes, which slows traffic and reduces crossing distance.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a basic sidewalk adjacent to a commercial car lot, but lacks essential crossing infrastructure at the signalized intersection. There are no visible crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or curb ramps, creating a hostile environment for people walking.

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalk
hazards.description: No marked crossing is provided at the signalized intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross without designated space.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area near the traffic light

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: Pedestrians have no visual indication of when it is safe to cross the street.

hazards.name: Missing Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The lack of curb ramps makes the sidewalk inaccessible for people with mobility devices.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install directional curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points.

result.summary: The environment is a wide, multi-lane commercial arterial with long crossing distances and minimal pedestrian protection. A narrow sidewalk is present but is compromised by poor drainage and its immediate proximity to high-speed traffic lanes.

hazards.name: Poor Drainage
hazards.description: Standing water in the gutter and sidewalk area forces pedestrians closer to traffic or into the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground along the curb line

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane roadway requires pedestrians to cross a wide expanse of traffic without a refuge island or median.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image across the main arterial

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Drainage Infrastructure Repair
interventions.description: Improve or clear catch basins to prevent water accumulation on the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Add a landscaped or physical buffer between the sidewalk and the travel lanes to improve safety and comfort.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane intersection in a commercial area dominated by car dealerships. The environment is highly hostile to pedestrians, characterized by a complete lack of visible sidewalks, marked crosswalks, or pedestrian signals.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross a very wide, multi-lane roadway without any marked crossing or refuge island, increasing exposure to high-speed traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: The absence of sidewalks forces any pedestrians to walk on unpaved shoulders or directly in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Perimeter of the roadway and intersection corners

hazards.name: Missing Pedestrian Control
hazards.description: While vehicle signals are present, there are no pedestrian signals to provide a dedicated phase for crossing.

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks and pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to all legs of the intersection.

interventions.title: Construct Continuous Sidewalks
interventions.description: Install paved sidewalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps to provide a safe, separated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised median islands to break up the long crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area for pedestrians.
